title: SQL foundations
description: Hollybank Vets keeps every owner, animal and visit in a database that only one of its vets knows how to question, so the front desk waits for him between appointments. You have never seen a database, and you start there: your first query, then choosing columns, choosing rows, matching text and handling the gaps in the records. Then you sort what comes back, count and total it, and group it. After that, you join tables: an animal with its owner, the rows with no match, and totals across tables. Last, you change the records safely, make new tables with rules that refuse bad rows, put a query inside a query, and make queries fast with indexes. Each issue teaches one part of SQL in small queries you run yourself against the practice's data.
